scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check db.js && find src test public -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:auto: node --check auto-server.js && find src/auto -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:structure: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const exact=(dir,want)=>{const got=fs.readdirSync(dir).sort();want=[...want].sort();if(JSON.stringify(got)!==JSON.stringify(want))throw new Error(dir+' drift: '+got.join(','));};const forbidden=['apps/cryptoworldz-web-core','apps/oneworldz-hub-central','apps/worldz-sites','master-use-library','media','diagnostics','docs','.github/certifications','archive'];for(const p of forbidden)if(fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('Retired path returned: '+p);exact('apps',['oneworldz-ecosystem-release']);exact('deployments',['README.md','oneworldz-19-total.request']);exact('tools',['resolve-community-facebook-metadata.mjs','verify-oneworldz-canonical.mjs']);if(fs.existsSync('apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release/scripts'))throw new Error('Retired static helper scripts directory returned');const gateway=fs.readFileSync('src/pdc-host.js','utf8');if(/WORLDZ_HOSTS|express\.static|cryptoworldz-web-core/.test(gateway))throw new Error('Retired public-domain fallback gateway returned');const wfDir='.github/workflows';const actual=fs.readdirSync(wfDir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.yml')||x.endsWith('.yaml')).sort();const allowed=['command-centre-v4.yml','main.yml','resolve-community-facebook-profiles.yml'].sort();if(JSON.stringify(actual)!==JSON.stringify(allowed))throw new Error('Workflow allowlist drift: '+actual.join(','));for(const file of actual.filter(x=>x!=='main.yml')){const text=fs.readFileSync(path.join(wfDir,file),'utf8');if(/FTP_HOST|FTP_USERNAME|FTP_PASSWORD|lftp|hostingerTransportDir|public_html/i.test(text))throw new Error('Static deployment authority leaked into '+file);}const sourceRoot='apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release/source';const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):[p];});for(const p of walk(sourceRoot)){if(/\.(png|jpe?g|webp|avif|gif|svg|ico)$/i.test(p)&&!p.startsWith(path.join(sourceRoot,'assets')+path.sep))throw new Error('Static image outside canonical assets root: '+p);}const gate=fs.readFileSync('governance/JAYJAY-CHATGPT-DEPLOYMENT-GATE.md','utf8');for(const token of ['Single-Rail Total Deployment Gate','HOSTINGER DESTINATION PASS','Only .github/workflows/main.yml may be used as the static-fleet execution rail','No-repeat approval rule for the current total deployment'])if(!gate.includes(token))throw new Error('Deployment gate drift: '+token);const state=fs.readFileSync('deployments/oneworldz-19-total.request','utf8');for(const token of ['state=TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE','owner_authority=PERFORM_TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN','canonical_deployment_rail=ONE_AUTHENTICATED_HOSTINGER_STATIC_FLEET_RAIL','hostinger_destination_pass=PASS_AUTHENTICATED_18_ROOT_PROOF_RECOVERED'])if(!state.includes(token))throw new Error('Deployment state drift: '+token);const targets=fs.readFileSync('apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release/production-targets.mjs','utf8');for(const token of ['TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE','ONE_AUTHENTICATED_HOSTINGER_STATIC_FLEET_RAIL','HOSTINGER_DESTINATION_PASS','PASS_AUTHENTICATED_18_ROOT_PROOF_RECOVERED','hostingerTransportDir'])if(!targets.includes(token))throw new Error('Target contract drift: '+token);"
scripts.verify:web: npm run check:structure && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm run check:web
scripts.verify: npm run check:structure && npm run check && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm test && npm run check:web && npm run check:auto
